title: Most capped players of the big nations
brief: Name each nation's most capped player in full internationals.
period: All full internationals to 19 July 2026. Germany includes West Germany.

notes.Harry Kane: Harry Kane had 121 caps on 19 July 2026, behind Peter Shilton's 125.
notes.Lilian Thuram: Lilian Thuram (142) is second for France behind Lloris.
notes.Miroslav Klose: Miroslav Klose (137) is second for Germany behind Matthaus.
notes.Iker Casillas: Iker Casillas (167) is second for Spain behind Ramos.
notes.Fabio Cannavaro: Fabio Cannavaro (136) is second for Italy behind Buffon.
notes.Edwin van der Sar: Edwin van der Sar (130) is second for the Netherlands behind Sneijder.
notes.Axel Witsel: Axel Witsel (140) is second for Belgium.
notes.Javier Mascherano: Javier Mascherano (147) is second for Argentina behind Messi.
notes.Neymar: Neymar (130) is behind Cafu for Brazil.
notes.Joao Moutinho: Joao Moutinho (146) is second for Portugal.

checks: Each record holder agrees between the nation's Wikipedia infobox, Wikipedia's 100-cap list and Transfermarkt's record caps page. Figures are FIFA official matches as Wikipedia and RSSSF give them; Transfermarkt has Cafu on 143. Matthaus's 150 include his West Germany caps. Messi and Ronaldo counted to 19 July 2026.
